shortDescription: Create, update or delete an OSPF interface configuration.

options.name: area_id
options.description: Unique identifier in X.X.X.X format.

options.name: bfd
options.description: Specifies whether the router global Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) mode should be overridden for this particular interface.

options.name: cost
options.description: Output cost configured for the interface.

options.name: dead_interval
options.description: The time duration, in seconds, that a neighbor should wait for a Hello packet before tearing down adjacencies with the local router.

options.name: hello_interval
options.description: The Hello packet will be sent every hello interval timer value seconds.

options.name: interface_name
options.description: Name of the Interface in which the OSPF process must be attached.

options.name: no_ospfv3_ipsec_ah
options.description: Option to delete ospfv3 IPsec AH configuration. This option is mutually exclusive with the `ospfv3_ipsec_ah` option.

options.name: ospf_id
options.description: OSPF process ID between numbers 1-63.

options.name: ospfv2_auth_keychain
options.description: Name of the "Keychain" used for cryptographic authentication. Supports MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512.

options.name: ospfv2_auth_md5_keys
options.description: The authentication keys for OSPFv2 authentication type "md5".

options.name: ospfv2_auth_sha_keys
options.description: The authentication keys for OSPFv2 authentication type "sha".

options.name: ospfv2_auth_text_key
options.description: The authentication key for OSPFv2 authentication type "text".

options.name: ospfv2_auth_type
options.description: The type of OSPFv2 authentication. If not set, then parent area level authentication holds for the port.

options.name: ospfv3_ipsec_ah
options.description: IPsec Authentication Header (AH) configuration. 'ospfv3_ipsec_ah' will be used if 'ospfv3_ipsec_esp' is also configured.

options.name: ospfv3_ipsec_esp
options.description: IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) configuration. 'ospfv3_ipsec_ah' will be used if 'ospfv3_ipsec_esp' is also configured.

options.name: priority
options.description: The router with the highest priority will be more eligible to become the Designated Router. Setting the value to 0, makes the router ineligible to become the Designated Router.

options.name: retransmit_interval
options.description: The number of seconds between LSA retransmissions.

options.name: shutdown
options.description: Shutdown OSPF functionalities on this interface.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, update, or delete the OSPF interface_name configuration.

options.name: transmit_delay
options.description: The estimated time in seconds to transmit an LSA to a neighbor.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of the OSPF network interface.

options.name: version
options.description: OSPF version. 'v2' for OSPFv2 and 'v3' for OSPFv3.

options.name: vrf
options.description: Alphanumeric name of the VRF the OSPF ID belongs to.
